# lineage-index

Authoritative inventory: which GitHub repos and local roots fed this pack.
Use this as the source-of-truth for "where did this branch come from?"

## Why this matters

Source-of-truth for which GitHub repos and which local agent-vm/host paths fed this transfer pack. Use it whenever you ask 'where did this branch come from?'

## What lives here

- `inventory/GITHUB_REPOS.md` — TrajanWJ EMA-related repos
- `inventory/LOCAL_ROOTS.md` — agent-vm/host paths (`/home/trajan/Projects/ema`, `/home/trajan/.openclaw`, `/home/trajan/vault`, `/home/trajan/wiki`, `/home/trajan/staging/host-vault`)
- `BRANCH_MAP.md` — original short branch list

## Where it connects

- `main` (which carries the rendered `SYSTEM_GRAPH.md`)
- Every `codebase-*` and `lineage-*` branch traces back to one of these roots.

## How to load it efficiently

```bash
git show origin/lineage-index:inventory/GITHUB_REPOS.md
git show origin/lineage-index:inventory/LOCAL_ROOTS.md
```
